fusions.name: Seam Driver
fusions.desc: A narrow-headed blow that deals 28 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Driven Tacks
fusions.desc: Flicks 3 tacks at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage with a 20% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Aimed Hand
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Nail Head
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 10%.
